descriptionChirho: Proper noun denoting Noah (Noakh), the righteous patriarch who built the ark and survived the great flood (Gen 5:29-32, 6:8-9:29), ancestor of all post-flood humanity. Also referenced in prophetic and wisdom literature (Isa 54:9, Ezek 14:14,20, 1 Chr 1:4). The three clusters differ only in grammatical form: standalone 'Noah' (41x), conjunctive 'and-Noah' (3x), and variant spelling 'Noach' (2x). Uniformly transliterated across languages: Spanish Noe/Noaj, Hindi नूह, Arabic نُوح, Korean 노아, Swahili Nuhu. All clusters represent the same person with no semantic distinction.
